apiErrors.database_schema_mismatch_admin: The database needs an update. Back up the SQLite database, run the matching command on the dtxWiki host, then retry. systemd: `sudo systemctl stop dtxwiki-worker dtxwiki && sudo -u dtxwiki bash -c 'set -a; source /etc/dtxwiki/dtxwiki.env; /opt/dtxwiki/.venv/bin/dtxwiki bootstrap' && sudo systemctl start dtxwiki dtxwiki-worker`. Docker: from `infra/prod`, run `docker compose stop app worker && docker compose run --rm init && docker compose up -d app worker caddy`. Source checkout: stop the app and worker, load their same environment, run `.venv/bin/dtxwiki bootstrap`, then restart both. Confirm `/health/ready` returns HTTP 200 before retrying.
